brief.idea: A terminal-first, local-only encrypted personal knowledge base and second brain built for paranoid security engineers and low-level programmers.

audience.primary: Kernel engineers, cryptographers, and infosec researchers
audience.context: Work in air-gapped or hardened Linux/BSD workstations, reject cloud telemetry, hate Electron memory bloat.

brief.problem: Modern note-taking tools are bloated, cloud-dependent Electron apps that leak metadata and demand mouse clicks.
brief.value: Sub-millisecond keyboard navigation, raw plaintext markdown, zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encryption on disk, zero cloud dependencies.
constraints: No cloud accounts or remote servers allowed
Must execute directly in TTY/terminal without GUI
No corporate SaaS jargon or friendly onboarding wizards
open_questions: Should multi-device sync be handled via git-crypt or raw P2P Tor onions?

qa.q: Who is the uncompromising user who would install this on day one?
qa.a: Paranoid security researchers and C/Rust programmers who write code in Neovim/tmux and refuse to store notes on Notion or Obsidian sync.

qa.q: What is the single failure mode this product must avoid at all costs?
qa.a: Accidental outbound network calls or telemetry. It must function perfectly with network cables unplugged.

qa.q: How does the pricing or distribution work?
qa.a: Open core CLI with paid encrypted offline peer-to-peer sync license.

directions.label: Archaic Industrial Brutalism
directions.positioning: A cold-forged, zero-telemetry crypt for thought. Built like a submarine bulkhead.
directions.value_proposition: Air-gapped markdown vault that treats memory as an operational secret.

traits.why: No social feeds, no sharing links, strictly solipsistic focus.
Resists feature creep and commercial telemetry by architectural design.
Single keystroke index lookups without latency or animation frames.

directions.name: KILN
directions.name_rationale: From metallurgical kilns: heat-treating raw thought into hardened, unalterable obsidian.
directions.one_line_pitch: A terminal-native, memory-hardened knowledge crypt that never dials home.

rules: Use terse declarative sentences; omit all conversational adjectives.
Reference hardware physics, cryptography, and storage primitives over abstractions.
Never promise ease or delight; promise inviolable integrity.
sample_messages: Vault encrypted with ChaCha20-Poly1305. 0 bytes transmitted. Terminal ready.
Index rebuilt in 1.4ms. Network interface unmapped.

typography.heading: Space Grotesk
typography.rationale: Engineered monospace with stark geometric title presence.

visual.shape_language: Rigid 1px borders, 0px border-radius, dense ASCII tabular hierarchy.
visual.image_style: Monochrome macro photography of cold rolled steel and circuit dies.

revisions.before: The smarter way to keep your developer notes private
revisions.reason: Replaced cliché 'smarter way to' pattern with uncompromising technical posture.
Eliminated generic SaaS stems '-term' and 'vault' in favor of raw industrial metaphor.

directions.label: Tactical Counter-Surveillance
directions.positioning: Operational intelligence notebook for adversarial environments.
directions.value_proposition: Denial-first documentation: plausible deniability vaults with decoy keystrokes.

traits.why: Assumes the host operating system is compromised.
Every byte of RAM allocated is verified and wiped on exit.
Rejects surveillance capitalism's capture of personal intellectual property.

directions.name: BLACKTAPE
directions.name_rationale: Physical analogy of black electrical tape covering webcams and sensor arrays.
directions.tagline: Your mind is classified. Act like it.
directions.one_line_pitch: Plausible deniability markdown engine for researchers in hostile networks.

rules: Frame data privacy as self-defense rather than a software preference.
Use operational field terminology rather than product management speak.
Refuse to congratulate the user for standard hygiene.
sample_messages: Session terminated. RAM scrubbed with random entropy. No residual state.

typography.heading: Syne
typography.rationale: Unapologetic angular typography paired with intelligence-dossier monospacing.

visual.shape_language: Warning stripes, dossier watermarks, bracketed coordinate labels.
visual.image_style: Stark thermal imagery, redacted document scans, and phosphor trace lines.

revisions.before: A secure second brain for smart people who care about security
revisions.after: Operational intelligence notebook for adversarial environments.
revisions.reason: Removed lazy 'second brain' trope and replaced with specific operational mandate.

directions.label: Stoic Archival Monasticism
directions.positioning: Enduring offline knowledge ledger designed to survive decades without upkeep.
directions.value_proposition: Zero-dependency plain text ledger compiled to static self-contained binary.

traits.why: Built to open identically in 2075 without backward incompatibility.
Rejects the dopamine cycle of hyperlinked notification noise.
Enforces clear atomic thinking over chaotic web clipping.

directions.name: MNEMONIC-0
directions.name_rationale: Mnemonic device stripped to zero baseline; foundational human recall.
directions.tagline: Notes for the next fifty years.
directions.one_line_pitch: Archival terminal notebook with guaranteed zero dependencies and offline longevity.

rules: Speak with historical gravity and long-term permanence.
Treat file formats as treaties: Plain UTF-8, zero proprietary encodings.
Focus on cognitive endurance over speed.
sample_messages: Record appended to ledger. Checksum verified against local root.
No network socket detected. As designed.

typography.heading: Newsreader
typography.rationale: Sublime archival serif heading combined with typewriter precision.

visual.shape_language: Bookbinding margins, subtle hairline rules, editorial grid systems.
visual.image_style: High-resolution architectural stone engravings and archival parchment details.

revisions.before: Next generation archival notes for everyone
revisions.after: Notes for the next fifty years.

required_traits: Hardware-level honesty (reference RAM, disk, cryptographic primitives)
Solipsistic posture (reject social features and sharing tropes)
voice_rules: State facts in declarative sentences; omit marketing hyperbole.
Never use exclamation marks or friendly exclamation phrases.
Address the user as an autonomous operator, never a consumer to be pampered.
Explicitly declare offline guarantees whenever describing system behavior.

rounds.attack: Meet KILN: The smart, intuitive notes app designed to seamlessly organize your thoughts.
rounds.new_rule: Ban 'meet [product]', 'intuitive', and 'smart'. State capability directly without welcoming gestures.

rounds.attack: Supercharge your developer productivity with our lightning-fast knowledge architecture.
rounds.new_rule: Ban 'supercharge' and 'productivity'. Emphasize tamper-proof integrity and zero network socket architecture.

rounds.attack: Enjoy peace of mind knowing your thoughts are safely protected by our friendly security model.
rounds.new_rule: Enforce zero-patronizing tone: never tell the user how to feel ('enjoy', 'delight', 'peace of mind').

launch.subhead: An unadorned terminal knowledge crypt compiled directly to native binary. Plaintext markdown encrypted on disk with ChaCha20-Poly1305. No cloud accounts. No telemetry. No Electron memory leaks.
launch.one_line_pitch: A memory-hardened terminal note vault for operators who treat thought as classified intelligence.
social_posts: Every major note-taking application is an Electron wrapper designed to monetize your intellectual property or leak metadata to third-party CDNs. KILN has zero network dependencies. Pull the Ethernet cable and inspect the memory dump.
KILN v1.0. 1.2MB binary. Sub-millisecond fuzzy search. ChaCha20-Poly1305 local encryption. Terminal only. Build from source or inspect the signatures.
If your notes require an internet connection to open, they are not your notes. KILN runs in your TTY. Always.
